butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **101:0.** بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ — Birincil okuma: Besmele, sûreye dışarıdan ekli bir formül değil; çarpma, dağılma ve ateş sahnesinin üstüne yerleştirilen yüksek bir ad/örtü gibi okunur. Sonraki “annesi Hâviye’dir” dönüşü, baştaki rahmet-rahim alanını daha da keskinleştirir: merhametli rahim/akrabalık matrisi, sonunda ana-kaynak diye beklenen yerin uçuruma dönüşmesiyle ters çevrilir. {س م و B005; س م و B001/B004; ء ل ه B002; ر ح م B001/B002/B003; ء م م B001/B002}

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **101:1.** ٱلْقَارِعَةُ — Birincil okuma: el-Qâriʿa önce bir olay adı değil, dikkati ve bilgiyi vuran ilk darbe gibi belirir. Sonraki insan ve dağ dağılması bu darbeyi açık, soyulmuş bir teşhir alanına çevirir; tartı ayetleri de onu payları ayıran bir seçme/adjudikasyon başlangıcı olarak geriye dönük etkinleştirir. {ق ر ع B001; ق ر ع B006; ق ر ع B010; ق ر ع B008/B011; ق ر ع B004; و ز ن B002}

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **101:2.** مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ — Birincil okuma: Soru, sıradan bilgi istemekten çok darbeyi ikinci kez yankılatır; tanım vermeyerek etkiyi büyütür. Sonraki tartı ve sonuç çiftleri, bu “ما”yı hükümden önceki belirsiz pay anı gibi okutur; cevap ise açıklama değil, en sonda maddî bir ateş olarak gelir. {ق ر ع B001/B006; ق ر ع B004; و ز ن B001/B002; ق ر ع B010; ف ر ش B001/B002}

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **101:3.** وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ — Birincil okuma: “Sana ne bildirdi?” formülü bilgiyi yumuşak bir açıklama değil, bilmenin sınırına çarpan epistemik bir darbe yapar. 101:10’daki tekrar bu ayeti iki aşamalı bir ifşanın ilk sarsıntısı hâline getirir; 101:9’daki ana/baş-çekirdeği ve yara alanı, bilginin saklı merkeze sivri biçimde yöneldiği ek bir beden imgesi açar. {د ر ي B001; ق ر ع B006/B001; د ر ي B002/B003/B004; ء م م B003; ه و ي B007; ن و ر B005}

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **101:4.** يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ — Birincil okuma: O gün, insan topluluğunun yönünü kaybedip salınan, çırpınan ve saçılan bir harekete dönüştüğü olay-gündür. butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **101:5.** وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ — Birincil okuma: En sert ve yüksek kütle, didiklenmiş yumuşak lif hâline gelir; fiziksel ağırlık ve sağlamlık çözülür. butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **101:6.** فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ — Birincil okuma: Dağların ağırlığı boşa çıktıktan sonra, tartıda geçerli olan başka bir ağırlık belirir: adalet karşısında anlamlı moral ağırlık. 101:7 bu ağırlığın koruyucu ve değer saklayıcı olduğunu; 101:8-11 ise terazinin kişiyi hangi kapatıcı mekâna teslim edeceğini belirlediğini gösterir. {ث ق ل B001/B004/B005/B006; و ز ن B001/B002/B005/B007; ج ب ل B001; ن ف ش B001; ع ي ش B001}

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **101:8.** وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ — Birincil okuma: Hafiflik burada özgürleşme değil, adalet terazisinde karşılık veremeyen değer eksikliğidir. 101:9 bu hafifliği kinetik ve yönlü yapar: ağırlıksız kişi yeniden çalkantılı harekete katılır ve Hâviye’ye doğru sürüklenir; 101:11’de hedefin ateş olması, hafifliği pervane trajedisine bağlar. {خ ف ف B001/B002/B004/B005; و ز ن B002/B007; ث ق ل B001; ن و س B001; ف ر ش B005; ه و ي B002/B008; ء م م B012/B013}

parent_channels.name: Impact Across Resistant Boundaries

subchannels.name: Blow, Descent, and Dispersive Impact
subchannels.scene_or_process: A blow or downward cast strikes a target and sends what was gathered into scattered motion.
subchannels.active_motifs: striking or knocking (ق ر ع:B001/m01); reaching or striking with hand or weapon (ه و ي:B003/m01); casting down (ه و ي:B003/m02); scattering after impact (ب ث ث:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:4 مبثوث (ب ث ث); 101:9 هاوية (ه و ي)
subchannels.synthesis: The قارعة is read through the concrete action of one thing striking another. The hand or weapon descends toward its object, and the impact converts cohesion into broadcast fragments or bodies.

subchannels.name: Cranial Breach and Gaping Wound
subchannels.scene_or_process: A strike crosses the outer head, reaches a thin cranial layer, and leaves an opened wound.
subchannels.active_motifs: head-strike (ق ر ع:B001/m01); cranial and bone plates (ف ر ش:B010/m01); wound reaching the bone layer (ف ر ش:B011/m01); brain or cranial membrane (ء م م:B003/m01); wound reaching the brain (ء م م:B003/m02); opened wound-mouth (ه و ي:B007/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م) and هاوية (ه و ي)
subchannels.synthesis: The striking action becomes a bodily penetration scene: force breaks through the head, reaches the thin supporting layer, and exposes the deeper cranial center as a gaping interior.

subchannels.name: Hard Ground, Pointed Tool, and Stabilized Edge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sharpened implement meets an unyielding substrate, while stonework fixes the edge of the opening.
subchannels.active_motifs: hard ground that stops digging (ج ب ل:B005/m01); hard stripped surface (ق ر ع:B011/m01); pointed horn or implement (د ر ي:B004/m01); stones lining a well (ح م ي:B011/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:3,10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي); 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:11 حامية (ح م ي)
subchannels.synthesis: Resistance, cutting point, and lining form one excavation mechanism. The solid layer halts ordinary digging, the pointed edge concentrates force, and large stones preserve the boundary once an opening is made.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Directed force meets a resistant surface and produces displacement, penetration, fracture, or an opened interior.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع) names the striking event, while 101:9 هاوية (ه و ي) supplies the downward or opened destination.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The catastrophic blow extends into cranial anatomy, sharp implements, excavation resistance, and stone lining.

parent_channels.name: Release Into Distributed Motion

subchannels.name: Moth-Swarm Scattering
subchannels.scene_or_process: Light flying bodies flutter toward a stimulus and lose collective order as they spread.
subchannels.active_motifs: flying moth (ف ر ش:B005/m01); fluttering toward light or fire (ف ر ش:B005/m02); scattering and broadcast spread (ب ث ث:B001/m01); agitated lightness (خ ف ف:B004/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 الفراش and مبثوث (ف ر ش، ب ث ث); 101:8 خفّت (خ ف ف)
subchannels.synthesis: The human multitude takes the motion signature of moths: light, agitated bodies converge on a luminous center while simultaneously dispersing into an ungoverned swarm.

subchannels.name: Carded Wool and Unmade Fabric
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dyed wool is beaten or teased until a compact textile mass becomes loose fiber.
subchannels.active_motifs: dyed wool (ع ه ن:B003/m01); carding and teasing wool (ن ف ش:B001/m01); fiber separation (ب ث ث:B001/m02); tightly made weave (ج ب ل:B007/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 مبثوث (ب ث ث); 101:5 العهن and المنفوش (ع ه ن، ن ف ش); 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل)
subchannels.synthesis: A contrast between tight fabrication and fiber release structures the scene. What could be spun or woven is worked backward into separated, buoyant strands, matching the mountains' loss of compact form.

subchannels.name: Night-Roaming Herd
subchannels.scene_or_process: Livestock leave ordered containment, spread through pasture at night, and move in a following procession.
subchannels.active_motifs: livestock dispersing at night without a shepherd (ن ف ش:B003/m01); young or low-bearing livestock (ف ر ش:B004/m01); camels following one another (خ ف ف:B008/m01); long part of the night (ه و ي:B006/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:5 المنفوش (ن ف ش); 101:8 خفّت (خ ف ف); 101:9 هاوية (ه و ي)
subchannels.synthesis: The release of animals has a temporal and processional shape: a herd spreads beyond supervision during the night, yet individual animals still trail one another through the pasture.

subchannels.name: Wing-Spreading and Brooding
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bird opens and fluffs its wings close to the ground, either fluttering or covering its young.
subchannels.active_motifs: wing-spreading near the ground (ف ر ش:B006/m01); brooding over chicks (ف ر ش:B006/m02); feather fluffing (ن ف ش:B002/m01); outward spread (ب ث ث:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 الفراش and مبثوث (ف ر ش، ب ث ث); 101:5 المنفوش (ن ف ش)
subchannels.synthesis: Distributed motion also serves care rather than disorder. Feathers open, wings flatten toward the ground, and the same spreading gesture that describes flutter can become a protective cover over offspring.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A compact body, flock, fiber mass, or ordered group opens into loose, repeated, or directionless movement.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 101:4 الفراش المبثوث (ف ر ش، ب ث ث) and 101:5 العهن المنفوش (ع ه ن، ن ف ش) present two successive dispersal images.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same release pattern joins moth flight, carded wool, roaming livestock, and a bird spreading itself over its young.

parent_channels.name: Measure as Outcome, Form, and Rank

subchannels.name: Scales That Determine Outcome
subchannels.scene_or_process: Deeds or values are placed in a balance, become heavy or light, and determine the resulting condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: physical and moral heaviness (ث ق ل:B001/m01, ث ق ل:B001/m02); light weight or load (خ ف ف:B001/m01); weighing and estimation (و ز ن:B001/m01); just balance and reckoning (و ز ن:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:6 ثقلت and موازينه (ث ق ل، و ز ن); 101:8 خفّت and موازينه (خ ف ف، و ز ن)
subchannels.synthesis: Weight is both mechanism and verdict. The balance compares what is presented, heaviness gives it consequence, and lightness marks insufficiency within the same act of reckoning.

subchannels.name: Quantity, Scarcity, and Multitude
subchannels.scene_or_process: A population or amount is estimated as abundant, standard, or deficient.
subchannels.active_motifs: known weight or standard measure (ث ق ل:B004/m01); appraisal or estimation (و ز ن:B001/m02); small amount or few persons (خ ف ف:B003/m01, خ ف ف:B003/m02); multitude like a mountain (ج ب ل:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:6 ثقلت and موازينه (ث ق ل، و ز ن); 101:8 خفّت (خ ف ف)
subchannels.synthesis: The physical scale generalizes into counting a collective. Mountain-like abundance occupies one end of the comparison, while lightness names a reduced crowd or diminished amount.

subchannels.name: Worth, Eminence, and Chosen Rank
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or possession acquires weight, is selected as the best, and becomes socially elevated.
subchannels.active_motifs: precious or weighty thing (ث ق ل:B005/m01); eminent person (ث ق ل:B005/m02); social worth (و ز ن:B007/m01); selected chief or best portion (ق ر ع:B007/m01); leaders likened to mountains (ج ب ل:B012/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:6 ثقلت and موازينه (ث ق ل، و ز ن); 101:8 موازينه (و ز ن)
subchannels.synthesis: Measured weight becomes rank. The valuable object and weighty person share a scale of consequence; selection raises one candidate above others, and mountain imagery gives that rank visible height and stability.

subchannels.name: Proportioned Creation and Embodied Form
subchannels.scene_or_process: A created body receives measured proportion, innate constitution, stature, and material thickness.
subchannels.active_motifs: balanced created form (و ز ن:B008/m01); innate constitution (ج ب ل:B004/m01); stature and bodily form (ء م م:B006/m01); good constitution (ء م م:B006/m02); bodily thickness and frame (ج ب ل:B003/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:6,8 موازينه (و ز ن); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م)
subchannels.synthesis: Weighing becomes formation rather than verdict. Proportion fixes the creature's measure, innate nature supplies its pattern, and stature and bodily thickness realize that pattern in visible form.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Comparison against a measure converts physical quantity into judgment, proportion, social worth, or a determined form.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 101:6 ثقلت موازينه and 101:8 خفت موازينه (ث ق ل، خ ف ف، و ز ن) state the decisive heavy-light contrast.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The scale extends from reckoning into demography, bodily proportion, leadership, preciousness, and intellectual steadiness.

parent_channels.name: Time Becoming Event

subchannels.name: Bounded Day and Extended Interval
subchannels.scene_or_process: Daylight supplies a bounded unit that can stretch into an unspecified period or a long portion of night.
subchannels.active_motifs: daylight day (ي و م:B001/m01); duration or age (ي و م:B002/m01); long interval or night portion (ه و ي:B006/m01); delayed span (ء م م:B008/m01); midday balance (و ز ن:B004/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 يوم (ي و م); 101:6,8 موازينه (و ز ن); 101:9 هاوية (ه و ي); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م)
subchannels.synthesis: The ordinary day anchors several scales of duration. Its midpoint is imagined as a poised balance, while its lexical field can widen to an age, a delay, or an extended passage through night.

subchannels.name: Calamity Entering Existence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A great occurrence arrives in time, becomes the prevailing condition, and can unfold as adversity or conflict.
subchannels.active_motifs: calamitous day or event (ي و م:B003/m01); occurrence in time (ك و ن:B001/m01); adverse condition (ك و ن:B006/m01); feud arising among people (ن و ر:B007/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 يوم and يكون (ي و م، ك و ن); 101:5 تكون (ك و ن); 101:11 نار (ن و ر)
subchannels.synthesis: Time is not a neutral container here: the day is the event itself. Coming-to-be gives the calamity presence, adverse condition gives it experiential force, and the feud sense shows how an occurrence can become a collective rupture.

subchannels.name: Detection, Knowledge, and Admission of an Event
subchannels.scene_or_process: An occurrence is sensed, understood, communicated, and finally acknowledged.
subchannels.active_motifs: visual detection (ء ن س:B002/m01); auditory detection (ء ن س:B002/m02); knowledge (د ر ي:B001/m01); informing another (د ر ي:B001/m02); acknowledgment or admission (ء م ه:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:3,10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي); no direct surface occurrence for ء ن س or ء م ه
subchannels.synthesis: The event moves through stages of cognition: perception supplies an initial signal, knowledge organizes it, communication transfers it, and admission turns inward recognition into an explicit response.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A span of time gains structure by being bounded, prolonged, filled by an occurrence, or recognized as a decisive event.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 101:4 يوم (ي و م) frames the transformations, and 101:4-5 يكون/تكون (ك و ن) present their coming into occurrence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Noon can be a balance, a day can be a battle or calamity, and an event can culminate in acknowledgment.

parent_channels.name: Centers That Generate, Hold, and Receive

subchannels.name: Mother as Origin and Destination
subchannels.scene_or_process: A maternal source gathers dependents and also names the place to which one returns or is delivered.
subchannels.active_motifs: mother or parent (ء م م:B001/m01); origin or source (ء م م:B002/m01); center and point of return (ء م م:B002/m03); lexical mother-base (ء م ه:B004/m01); abyss or receiving depth (ه و ي:B002/m02)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:9 أمّه and هاوية (ء م م، ه و ي); no direct surface occurrence for ء م ه
subchannels.synthesis: The mother sense and the origin-center sense converge on return. What first generates and gathers can also name the receiving destination, allowing the abyss to function as an inverted maternal center.

subchannels.name: Nurturer, Nest, and Available Provision
subchannels.scene_or_process: A caregiver prepares an enclosure and keeps the food or means of life immediately available within it.
subchannels.active_motifs: feeding and rearing (ء م م:B001/m02); prepared nest or dwelling (ف ر ش:B002/m02); present and accessible provision (ع ه ن:B001/m01); means of livelihood (ع ي ش:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:5 العهن (ع ه ن); 101:7 عيشة (ع ي ش); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م)
subchannels.synthesis: Care is spatial as well as social. The nurturer lays out a protected place, places sustenance within reach, and turns the enclosure into a functioning habitat rather than a passive container.

subchannels.name: Womb, Pregnancy, and Breeding
subchannels.scene_or_process: Reproduction joins the breeding male, the receptive womb, its internal vessels, and the burden of gestation.
subchannels.active_motifs: breeding or mounting by a male (ق ر ع:B003/m01); womb vessels or womb-place (ع ه ن:B005/m01); pregnancy as carried weight (ث ق ل:B007/m01); protected breeding camel (ح م ي:B005/m01); young livestock (ف ر ش:B004/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:5 العهن (ع ه ن); 101:6 ثقلت (ث ق ل); 101:11 حامية (ح م ي)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene follows generation from mating to gestation. The male's reproductive action meets the womb's internal structure, pregnancy converts conception into sustained weight, and the livestock frame carries the process toward offspring.

subchannels.name: Receptacle, Spread Surface, and Release
subchannels.scene_or_process: A vessel gathers material, opens onto a laid surface, and releases its contents into distribution.
subchannels.active_motifs: sack or collecting receptacle (ق ر ع:B012/m01); gathering center (ء م م:B002/m02); laying out a surface (ف ر ش:B001/m01); spreading stored contents (ب ث ث:B001/m02)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:4 الفراش and مبثوث (ف ر ش، ب ث ث); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م)
subchannels.synthesis: Containment and dispersal form a single mechanism. Material first acquires a center in the vessel, then the vessel is opened over a prepared surface and its contents cease to be a compact store.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A center can be an origin, parent, womb, prepared enclosure, collecting vessel, or final place of return.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 101:9 أمّه هاوية (ء م م، ه و ي) fuses motherhood or origin with a receiving abyss.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Maternal nurture connects with nests, provisions, gestation, breeding, sacks, and the release of stored contents.

parent_channels.name: Orientation Through Leaders, Marks, and Aims

subchannels.name: Leader, Exemplar, and Beacon
subchannels.scene_or_process: A selected leader stands visibly ahead, is followed as a model, and marks the route for others.
subchannels.active_motifs: leader or exemplar (ء م م:B009/m01); selected chief or best member (ق ر ع:B007/m01); leaders and scholars as mountains (ج ب ل:B012/m01); beacon or route marker (ن و ر:B005/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م); 101:11 نار (ن و ر)
subchannels.synthesis: Selection, elevation, and visibility produce guidance. The chief is chosen from the group, stands with mountain-like prominence, and becomes a marker by which those behind can orient themselves.

subchannels.name: Guide-Line and Constructed Alignment
subchannels.scene_or_process: A line, board, or other standard is placed first so later work can be aligned and woven or built against it.
subchannels.active_motifs: guide-line or construction standard (ء م م:B009/m02); alignment between two things (و ز ن:B003/m01); skillful tight weaving (ج ب ل:B007/m01); visible road or house forecourt (ق ر ع:B010/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:6,8 موازينه (و ز ن); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م)
subchannels.synthesis: Exemplarity becomes a material procedure. The first line or support establishes direction, comparison keeps each later element parallel, and the resulting fabric or structure inherits the standard's order.

subchannels.name: Aim, Lot, and Destination
subchannels.scene_or_process: Intention fixes a target, a lot selects among alternatives, and movement is directed toward the chosen place.
subchannels.active_motifs: intention and deliberate aim (ء م م:B012/m01); directing a projectile (ء م م:B012/m02); lot or apportioned choice (ق ر ع:B004/m01); seeking a target or place (د ر ي:B002/m01); place or position (ك و ن:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:3,10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي); 101:4-5 يكون/تكون (ك و ن); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م)
subchannels.synthesis: Selection and intention converge on directed action. The lot identifies one possibility, the will adopts it as a target, and spatial position turns that abstract choice into a destination.

subchannels.name: Stewardship of Weighty Resources
subchannels.scene_or_process: A capable person is chosen to guard valuable property, judge its use, and answer for it.
subchannels.active_motifs: competent stewardship of wealth (ع ه ن:B007/m01); chosen chief (ق ر ع:B007/m01); precious or weighty property (ث ق ل:B005/m01); sound and settled judgment (و ز ن:B005/m01); sponsorship or responsibility (ك و ن:B003/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:4-5 يكون/تكون (ك و ن); 101:5 العهن (ع ه ن); 101:6 ثقلت and موازينه (ث ق ل، و ز ن)
subchannels.synthesis: Authority is defined by care rather than position alone. Valuable material requires a selected custodian whose judgment is steady and whose role makes him answerable for preservation and allocation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A selected center or standard organizes direction, alignment, imitation, destination, and responsible action.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع), 101:3,10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي), 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل), and 101:9 أمّه (ء م م) carry the roots whose latent senses form the directional frame.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A leader can function like a road marker, guide-line, construction standard, chosen lot, or steward of measured resources.

parent_channels.name: Directed Pursuit and Rapid Passage

subchannels.name: Concealed Hunter and Skittish Prey
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hunter hides behind an animal, approaches without alarming prey, and casts or reaches at the decisive moment.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealment for hunting (د ر ي:B003/m01); tame animal or reassuring companion (ء ن س:B003/m02); skittish flight from approach (ن و ر:B006/m01); reaching or casting with hand or weapon (ه و ي:B003/m01); hoof or foot of the mount (خ ف ف:B006/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:3,10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي); 101:8 خفّت (خ ف ف); 101:9 هاوية (ه و ي); 101:11 نار (ن و ر); no direct surface occurrence for ء ن س
subchannels.synthesis: Pursuit depends on managing visibility and alarm. The mount masks the hunter, its familiar presence delays the prey's flight, and the concealed approach ends in a sudden cast or reach.

subchannels.name: Raid Toward a Defended Target
subchannels.scene_or_process: A party chooses a place, advances toward it as a raid, and meets protection or exclusion at the target.
subchannels.active_motifs: raid or hostile seeking (د ر ي:B002/m02); deliberate target (ء م م:B012/m01); place or position (ك و ن:B002/m01); taking a path (ف ر ش:B007/m02); defense and prevention of approach (ح م ي:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:3,10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي); 101:4 الفراش and يكون (ف ر ش، ك و ن); 101:5 تكون (ك و ن); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م); 101:11 حامية (ح م ي)
subchannels.synthesis: The raid is a directed conflict scene rather than motion alone. Intention fixes the destination, the route carries the attackers toward it, and protection defines the target by controlling who may approach.

subchannels.name: Swift Travel, Swoop, and Mountain Entry
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler or animal moves rapidly, enters rough high terrain, and may descend or swoop with concentrated speed.
subchannels.active_motifs: rapid departure or travel (خ ف ف:B002/m01); swift animal motion (خ ف ف:B002/m02); fast descent, run, or swoop (ه و ي:B008/m01); entry into mountains (ج ب ل:B006/m01); hard stripped terrain (ق ر ع:B011/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:8 خفّت (خ ف ف); 101:9 هاوية (ه و ي)
subchannels.synthesis: Speed is shaped by terrain. Light rapid movement carries the traveler into the mountains, while the swoop sense compresses distance vertically and the hard surface gives the passage a resistant ground.

subchannels.name: Processional Herd Through Night
subchannels.scene_or_process: Animals move one behind another through an extended night interval after dispersing from supervision.
subchannels.active_motifs: following camel procession (خ ف ف:B008/m01); livestock dispersing at night (ن ف ش:B003/m01); young herd animals (ف ر ش:B004/m01); extended night interval (ه و ي:B006/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:5 المنفوش (ن ف ش); 101:8 خفّت (خ ف ف); 101:9 هاوية (ه و ي)
subchannels.synthesis: Dispersal and procession coexist: the herd leaves controlled pasture, yet its members preserve a serial relation as they travel through the night.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Intention becomes motion through concealment, targeting, route choice, speed, encounter, and defensive response.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 101:3,10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي), 101:8 خفّت (خ ف ف), and 101:9 هاوية (ه و ي) anchor lexical senses of seeking, swift travel, casting, and descent.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The network moves from a hunter hidden behind a mount to raids, mountain entry, swooping flight, and a night-moving herd.

parent_channels.name: Rebalancing Relations Between Wills

subchannels.name: Acceptance and Satisfied Life
subchannels.scene_or_process: Aversion ceases, acceptance settles, and the accepted condition becomes a satisfying mode of life.
subchannels.active_motifs: acceptance opposed to displeasure (ر ض و:B001/m01); abundant or sought satisfaction (ر ض و:B002/m01); accepted state (ر ض ي:B001/m01); condition of living (ع ي ش:B001/m02)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:7 راضية and عيشة (ر ض و، ع ي ش); no direct surface occurrence for ر ض ي
subchannels.synthesis: Satisfaction is both relation and condition. Acceptance removes resistance to what is given, and that settled relation becomes the quality of the life being lived.

subchannels.name: Reciprocal Agreement and Shared Lot
subchannels.scene_or_process: Members of a group allocate a matter, accept one another's share, and seal the arrangement by reciprocal undertaking.
subchannels.active_motifs: mutual satisfaction (ر ض و:B003/m01); drawing or allocating lots (ق ر ع:B004/m01); community joined by one matter (ء م م:B004/m01); reciprocal covenant (ء م ه:B005/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:7 راضية (ر ض و); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م); no direct surface occurrence for ء م ه
subchannels.synthesis: The lot converts uncertainty into an allocation, but the social result depends on mutual acceptance. Community and covenant transform the selected share into a durable agreement.

subchannels.name: Placation, Correction, and Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: Displeasure is met by effortful appeasement and corrective speech until the hearer turns back or complies.
subchannels.active_motifs: seeking another's satisfaction (ر ض و:B004/m01); rebuke that causes retreat (ق ر ع:B006/m01); preparing or smoothing the way (ف ر ش:B001/m02); compliance and obedience (خ ف ف:B007/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:7 راضية (ر ض و); 101:8 خفّت (خ ف ف)
subchannels.synthesis: Reconciliation has both verbal and spatial imagery. Rebuke interrupts the wrong course, appeasement removes resistance, and smoothing the way makes return and compliance possible.

subchannels.name: Rivalry and Overcoming
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two parties contest an issue, persist against one another, and end with one prevailing.
subchannels.active_motifs: armed or personal contest (ق ر ع:B002/m01); overcoming a rival (ر ض و:B005/m01); prevailing in contention (ر ض ي:B002/m01); mutual persistence in dispute (ه و ي:B009/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:7 راضية (ر ض و); 101:9 هاوية (ه و ي); no direct surface occurrence for ر ض ي
subchannels.synthesis: The acceptance field reverses into competitive mastery. Mutual persistence holds the parties in conflict until contest resolves the relation by giving one will precedence.

subchannels.name: Obedience, Guarantee, and Responsibility
subchannels.scene_or_process: A participant accepts direction, stands surety for another, and assumes continuing responsibility.
subchannels.active_motifs: obedient relation (ر ض و:B006/m01); guarantor or surety (ر ض و:B006/m03); guarantee relation (ر ض ي:B004/m03); compliance (خ ف ف:B007/m01); sponsorship or responsibility (ك و ن:B003/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4-5 يكون/تكون (ك و ن); 101:7 راضية (ر ض و); 101:8 خفّت (خ ف ف); no direct surface occurrence for ر ض ي
subchannels.synthesis: Acceptance becomes obligation when it binds future action. Obedience aligns conduct with another's direction, while surety makes that alignment answerable on another person's behalf.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Social relations change when participants accept, negotiate, appease, correct, overcome, obey, or guarantee one another.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 101:7 راضية (ر ض و) supplies the acceptance pole, while 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع) contributes latent contest, lot, and rebuke senses.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Satisfaction can become reciprocal settlement, corrective speech, rivalry, or legally answerable commitment.

parent_channels.name: Heat, Light, and Inscribed Trace

subchannels.name: Flame and Intensified Heat
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible fire burns with increasing heat and transfers that heat to its surroundings or to worked material.
subchannels.active_motifs: flame or kindled fire (ن و ر:B002/m01); intense heat (ح م ي:B001/m01); heating iron or a tool (ح م ي:B001/m02); illumination produced by fire (ن و ر:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:11 نار and حامية (ن و ر، ح م ي)
subchannels.synthesis: Fire joins visibility and temperature in one source. Its light announces its presence, while its heat acts on bodies and materials beyond the flame itself.

subchannels.name: Illumination and Detection
subchannels.scene_or_process: Light makes an object perceptible, after which sight or hearing becomes knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: illumination (ن و ر:B001/m01); visual detection (ء ن س:B002/m01); auditory detection (ء ن س:B002/m02); knowledge gained (د ر ي:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:3,10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي); 101:11 نار (ن و ر); no direct surface occurrence for ء ن س
subchannels.synthesis: Illumination is the external condition for recognition, while sensing is the receiving operation. What appears or sounds is converted from signal into understood content.

subchannels.name: Point, Venom, and Pigmented Mark
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sharp point pierces a surface, introduces a heated substance or dark pigment, and leaves a visible bodily trace.
subchannels.active_motifs: pointed implement (د ر ي:B004/m01); heat of venom or sting (ح م ي:B007/m01); soot used after skin-pricking for tattoo or cosmetic mark (ن و ر:B008/m01); red flower image (ع ه ن:B009/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:3,10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي); 101:5 العهن (ع ه ن); 101:11 نار and حامية (ن و ر، ح م ي)
subchannels.synthesis: Penetration, heat, and color form an inscription mechanism. A point opens the skin, an active substance enters or is spread over it, and red or dark coloration makes the event persist as a mark.

subchannels.name: Darkened Medium and Residual Surface
subchannels.scene_or_process: Air, water, or earth becomes dark and dense, then leaves a visible deposit or dried trace on the surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: blackened night or cloud mass (ح م ي:B012/m01); black foul mud (ح م ي:B006/m01); dried trace after water recedes (ف ر ش:B009/m01); residual water or surface bubbles (ف ر ش:B009/m02)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:11 حامية (ح م ي)
subchannels.synthesis: Obscuration is material as well as atmospheric. Darkness accumulates overhead, mud thickens below, and receding liquid records its former presence as a skin, residue, or bubble field.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Thermal or luminous intensity changes bodies and surfaces by heating, revealing, marking, darkening, or leaving residue.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 101:11 نار حامية (ن و ر، ح م ي) unites flame with intensified heat.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Fire extends into perception, heated tools, venom, tattoo pigment, dark clouds, mud, and water traces.

parent_channels.name: Shell, Lining, Opening, and Void

subchannels.name: Mountain Mass, Hard Substrate, and Well Lining
subchannels.scene_or_process: A high solid mass becomes an unyielding ground, and large stones are arranged to preserve a hollow cut through it.
subchannels.active_motifs: high solid mountain mass (ج ب ل:B001/m01); hard substrate stopping excavation (ج ب ل:B005/m01); stone lining of a well (ح م ي:B011/m01); hard smooth surface (ق ر ع:B011/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:11 حامية (ح م ي)
subchannels.synthesis: Solidity and hollow construction are complementary. The mountain-like substrate resists penetration, but once opened, a ring of stone converts that breach into a stable, usable depth.

subchannels.name: Bodily Plates, Muscle, and Hoof Edges
subchannels.scene_or_process: Thin hard layers and thicker soft components assemble into a supported bodily mechanism.
subchannels.active_motifs: thin cranial or bone plate (ف ر ش:B010/m01); thin metal or mechanical plate (ف ر ش:B010/m02); skin, scalp, or bone layer (ج ب ل:B003/m02); protruding calf muscle (ح م ي:B009/m01); paired sides of the hoof (ح م ي:B010/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:11 حامية (ح م ي)
subchannels.synthesis: The body is rendered as layered construction. Thin plates provide interface and protection, muscle supplies volume and motion, and paired hoof edges organize contact with the ground.

subchannels.name: Forecourt, Route, and Gaping Entrance
subchannels.scene_or_process: An exposed court opens onto a route, presents a visible entrance, and can be marked for approach.
subchannels.active_motifs: road or house forecourt (ق ر ع:B010/m01); taking a path (ف ر ش:B007/m02); gaping opening or hollow interior (ه و ي:B007/m01); visible route marker (ن و ر:B005/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:9 هاوية (ه و ي); 101:11 نار (ن و ر)
subchannels.synthesis: The forecourt mediates outside and inside. The route reaches an exposed frontage, the opening admits passage into a hollow interior, and the marker keeps the approach legible.

subchannels.name: Bared Surface and Empty Interior
subchannels.scene_or_process: Covering disappears from head, land, enclosure, or heart, exposing a bare surface and the void behind it.
subchannels.active_motifs: baldness, denudation, or emptied enclosure (ق ر ع:B008/m01, ق ر ع:B008/m02); air or void (ه و ي:B001/m01); emptied heart without steadiness (ه و ي:B001/m02); dry stripped wood (ج ب ل:B008/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:9 هاوية (ه و ي)
subchannels.synthesis: Loss of covering produces both visual exposure and structural emptiness. Bald ground, dry wood, and the vacant interior share a movement from occupied or clothed form to uncovered void.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodies and places are organized by outer surfaces, supporting layers, bounded openings, and the empty spaces those boundaries contain.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل), 101:9 هاوية (ه و ي), and 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع) anchor solidity, depth, surface exposure, and forecourt senses.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Mountain and abyss imagery extends into wells, skull plates, muscles, hoof edges, door courts, bald ground, and hollow interiors.

parent_channels.name: Human Collectivity, Nature, and Transmission

subchannels.name: Human Community and Multitude
subchannels.scene_or_process: Individual humans become a named community whose scale ranges from a small group to a mountain-like multitude.
subchannels.active_motifs: human being or human collective (ء ن س:B001/m01); community joined by one matter (ء م م:B004/m01); great multitude (ج ب ل:B002/m01); few persons or reduced crowd (خ ف ف:B003/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:8 خفّت (خ ف ف); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م); no direct surface occurrence for ء ن س, while الناس occurs at 101:4 under ن و س
subchannels.synthesis: The scene moves between person, group, and scale. Shared affiliation turns humans into a community, while mountain abundance and numerical lightness describe expansion and contraction of that collective.

subchannels.name: Innate Nature and Human Form
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person begins from an unlearned natural condition and receives an embodied, proportioned constitution.
subchannels.active_motifs: innate disposition (ج ب ل:B004/m01); created nature (ج ب ل:B004/m02); primordial non-book condition (ء م م:B007/m02); balanced created form (و ز ن:B008/m01); bodily stature (ء م م:B006/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:6,8 موازينه (و ز ن); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م)
subchannels.synthesis: Human identity begins before acquired convention. Innate disposition supplies the pattern, measured creation gives it proportion, and stature makes that native constitution bodily visible.

subchannels.name: Creed as Followed Way
subchannels.scene_or_process: A community receives a creed or customary path, learns it, and follows an authoritative transmitter.
subchannels.active_motifs: creed or religious tradition (ء م م:B005/m01); followed way and obedience (ء م م:B005/m02); informing another (د ر ي:B001/m02); leader or exemplar (ء م م:B009/m01); reciprocal undertaking (ء م ه:B005/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:3,10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م); no direct surface occurrence for ء م ه
subchannels.synthesis: Tradition is a directed social transmission. Knowledge is communicated, an exemplar embodies the path, and communal undertaking turns what is taught into a practice that can be followed.

subchannels.name: Elder, Memory, and Non-Written Transmission
subchannels.scene_or_process: An aged speaker looks back on earlier life and carries knowledge without relying on writing.
subchannels.active_motifs: elder defined by recollection of former youth (ك و ن:B005/m01); nonwriter or nonreader (ء م م:B007/m01); knowledge (د ر ي:B001/m01); informing another (د ر ي:B001/m02); extended lifetime (ي و م:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:3,10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي); 101:4 يوم and يكون (ي و م، ك و ن); 101:5 تكون (ك و ن); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م)
subchannels.synthesis: The elder's repeated “I was” turns elapsed life into testimony. Knowledge persists through memory and speech even where textual literacy is absent.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human identity is formed through bodily nature, membership in a collective, inherited practice, and the transmission of knowledge across a lifetime.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 101:4 الناس, indexed under ن و س, supplies the human collective, while 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل), 101:9 أمّه (ء م م), and 101:3,10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي) anchor the latent formation and transmission senses.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A people can be mountain-like in number, a creed can function as a followed road, and an elder's remembered life can preserve non-written knowledge.

parent_channels.name: Conditions of Living and Provision

subchannels.name: Immediate Livelihood and Protected Habitat
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food and other means of living are kept ready inside a prepared and defended dwelling.
subchannels.active_motifs: present accessible provision (ع ه ن:B001/m01); livelihood and subsistence (ع ي ش:B002/m01); prepared bedding or household furnishing (ف ر ش:B002/m01); protection and exclusion of harm (ح م ي:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:5 العهن (ع ه ن); 101:7 عيشة (ع ي ش); 101:11 حامية (ح م ي)
subchannels.synthesis: Sustenance requires arrangement. Resources must be available, the dwelling must be fitted for use, and protection preserves both inhabitants and provisions from interruption.

subchannels.name: Blessed and Satisfying Life
subchannels.scene_or_process: A favorable condition supplies the goods of life and is received with settled satisfaction.
subchannels.active_motifs: blessing or good condition (ء م م:B010/m01); life and living condition (ع ي ش:B001/m01, ع ي ش:B001/m02); abundant satisfaction (ر ض و:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:7 عيشة and راضية (ع ي ش، ر ض و); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م)
subchannels.synthesis: Well-being joins circumstance and response. Blessing names the favorable state, life is its field of realization, and satisfaction is the participant's settled relation to it.

subchannels.name: Poverty, Adversity, and Diminished Standing
subchannels.scene_or_process: Material slackness becomes a bad condition in which a person or right is treated as small and negligible.
subchannels.active_motifs: slackness or poverty (ع ه ن:B002/m02); adverse condition (ك و ن:B006/m01); contempt or humiliation (خ ف ف:B005/m01); disregard of a right (خ ف ف:B005/m02); lowly or slight standing (ء م م:B013/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4-5 يكون/تكون (ك و ن); 101:5 العهن (ع ه ن); 101:8 خفّت (خ ف ف); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م)
subchannels.synthesis: Diminution moves from resources to status. Poverty weakens material capacity, adverse condition fixes that weakness as a mode of life, and contempt translates it into social devaluation.

subchannels.name: Submission and Bonded Service
subchannels.scene_or_process: A subordinate person yields, obeys direction, and occupies a socially dependent role.
subchannels.active_motifs: submission or abasement (ك و ن:B004/m01); obedience and compliance (خ ف ف:B007/m01); bondmaid or young female servant (ء م م:B014/m01); obedient relation (ر ض ي:B004/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4-5 يكون/تكون (ك و ن); 101:8 خفّت (خ ف ف); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م); no direct surface occurrence for ر ض ي
subchannels.synthesis: Subordination is expressed both as bodily yielding and durable social position. Compliance performs the relation, while bonded status makes it continuing rather than momentary.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Life takes shape through available resources, prepared habitation, protection, satisfaction, deprivation, or subordinate service.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 101:7 عيشة راضية (ع ي ش، ر ض و) names the fulfilled condition, while 101:4-5 يكون/تكون (ك و ن) supplies the broader field of states.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Provision connects with bedding and protection, while adverse condition extends into poverty, contempt, submission, and bonded status.

parent_channels.name: Hidden Content Entering Knowledge or Speech

subchannels.name: Signal, Sensation, and Knowledge
subchannels.scene_or_process: An external strike, light, sound, or felt alarm produces perception and becomes understood information.
subchannels.active_motifs: audible or felt knock (ق ر ع:B001/m01); visual detection (ء ن س:B002/m01); auditory detection (ء ن س:B002/m02); felt alarm (ء ن س:B002/m03); knowledge (د ر ي:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:3,10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي); no direct surface occurrence for ء ن س
subchannels.synthesis: The hidden event first announces itself as impact or sensation. Perception receives the signal through sight, hearing, or inward alarm, and knowledge identifies what that signal means.

subchannels.name: Disclosure, Investigation, and Unrestrained Speech
subchannels.scene_or_process: Concealed information is brought out, examined, and then spread in speech without restraint.
subchannels.active_motifs: revealing news or a secret (ب ث ث:B002/m01); investigating and uncovering a matter (ب ث ث:B003/m01); unrestrained speech (ف ر ش:B012/m01); slanderous speech (ف ر ش:B012/m02); speech cast without deliberation (ع ه ن:B006/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 مبثوث and الفراش (ب ث ث، ف ر ش); 101:5 العهن (ع ه ن)
subchannels.synthesis: Disclosure begins as the opening of something hidden, but its social trajectory depends on restraint. Investigation can clarify the matter; uncontrolled spreading can instead turn it into careless or harmful speech.

subchannels.name: Grief Poured Out to a Confidant
subchannels.scene_or_process: Internal grief is disclosed to a trusted companion whose presence removes isolation.
subchannels.active_motifs: pouring out grief and distress (ب ث ث:B002/m02); intimate or chosen companion (ء ن س:B006/m02); companionship that removes loneliness (ء ن س:B003/m01); inner self or psyche (ء ن س:B006/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 مبثوث (ب ث ث); no direct surface occurrence for ء ن س
subchannels.synthesis: Broadcasting becomes intimate rather than public. What is compressed within the self is released in speech to a chosen listener, and companionship changes disclosure into relief from isolation.

subchannels.name: Rebuke, Hearing, and Sound Judgment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Corrective speech reaches a listener, overcomes impaired reception, and calls for a steady judgment and acknowledgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: rebuke that turns the hearer back (ق ر ع:B006/m01); impaired hearing (ث ق ل:B009/m01); settled and weighty judgment (و ز ن:B005/m01); acknowledgment (ء م ه:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:6 ثقلت and موازينه (ث ق ل، و ز ن); no direct surface occurrence for ء م ه
subchannels.synthesis: Correction succeeds only when forceful speech becomes heard and weighed. The rebuke breaks through resistance, judgment tests its truth, and acknowledgment completes the listener's return.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What is concealed in an event, mind, or social relation becomes perceptible, communicable, disclosed, corrected, or distorted in utterance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 101:3 and 101:10 أَدْرَىٰ (د ر ي) foreground knowing, while 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع) supplies a latent signal or rebuke that reaches a hearer.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Disclosure ranges from sensed alarm and reported news to poured-out grief, slander, rebuke, impaired hearing, and vacuous speech.

parent_channels.name: Plant Growth, Fiber, and Hollowing

subchannels.name: Blossom, Spreading Growth, and Palm Frond
subchannels.scene_or_process: A plant puts out visible bloom, spreads close to the ground, and organizes new growth around a central palm heart.
subchannels.active_motifs: flower or blossom (ن و ر:B004/m01); spreading crop or plant (ف ر ش:B008/m01); fronds near the palm heart (ع ه ن:B004/m01); base of the date cluster (ع ه ن:B010/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:5 العهن (ع ه ن); 101:11 نار (ن و ر)
subchannels.synthesis: Growth moves outward from a center. The cluster base and inner fronds define plant architecture, spreading vegetation occupies the surrounding surface, and blossom makes maturation visible.

subchannels.name: Weave, Wool, and Fiber Release
subchannels.scene_or_process: Organic fiber is gathered into a tight fabric and can later be teased back into loose strands.
subchannels.active_motifs: dyed wool (ع ه ن:B003/m01); skilled tight weaving (ج ب ل:B007/m01); laying fiber or cloth out (ف ر ش:B001/m01); carding wool apart (ن ف ش:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:5 الجبال, العهن, and المنفوش (ج ب ل، ع ه ن، ن ف ش)
subchannels.synthesis: Fabrication and dissolution are inverse operations on the same material. Weaving gathers and tensions fibers into structure; laying out and carding release that structure into a spread mass.

subchannels.name: Gourd, Dry Wood, and Withering
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fruit-bearing plant matures around a hollow form while surrounding wood or brush dries and loses vitality.
subchannels.active_motifs: gourd or squash fruit (ق ر ع:B009/m01); dry wood (ج ب ل:B008/m01); small brush or twigs (ف ر ش:B008/m02); black mud as growth medium (ح م ي:B006/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:11 حامية (ح م ي)
subchannels.synthesis: The plant scene contrasts retained fruit-form with environmental depletion. The gourd preserves a rounded hollow body as twigs and wood dry, while dark earth remains the material base from which growth arose.

subchannels.name: Hollow Fruit and Empty Utterance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hollow plant-form becomes an analogy for speech that has shape and spread but lacks substantive content.
subchannels.active_motifs: gourd or hollow squash (ق ر ع:B009/m01); vain or nonsensical speech (ه و ي:B010/m01); speech thrown out without deliberation (ع ه ن:B006/m01); broadcasting an utterance (ب ث ث:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:4 مبثوث (ب ث ث); 101:5 العهن (ع ه ن); 101:9 هاوية (ه و ي)
subchannels.synthesis: Exterior form and interior content are pulled apart. The gourd supplies the image of a bounded hollow body, while careless or vain speech supplies verbal form that circulates without corresponding substance.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Organic materials move through growth, branching, fabrication, drying, loosening, and hollowing.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 101:5 العهن المنفوش (ع ه ن، ن ف ش) supplies the fiber transformation, while 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع) carries the latent gourd sense.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Palm anatomy, flowering plants, woven cloth, dry wood, gourd fruit, and empty speech share transformations of filled and hollow form.

parent_channels.name: S1. Pupil, Reflected Figure, and Visual Defect
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A human likeness appears in the dark center of the eye, while defect or obscuration disrupts that visual field.
parent_channels.active_motifs: reflected human figure in the pupil (ء ن س:B005/m01); bodily defect (ء م م:B015/m01); blackening or dark clouding (ح م ي:B012/m01)
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 101:9 أمّه (ء م م); 101:11 حامية (ح م ي); no direct surface occurrence for ء ن س
parent_channels.synthesis: The pupil is both organ and image-bearing surface: it contains the tiny human figure seen by an observer. Defect and darkening alter that capacity to receive or display a visible form.

parent_channels.name: S2. Woman Within Household Appraisal
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A woman is located within household kinship and described through stature, bodily form, composure, and dependent status.
parent_channels.active_motifs: short-statured woman (و ز ن:B006/m01); full-bodied woman and dignified composure (ث ق ل:B008/m01, ث ق ل:B008/m02); bondmaid or young female servant (ء م م:B014/m01); relatives by marriage (ح م ي:B004/m01)
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 101:6 ثقلت and موازينه (ث ق ل، و ز ن); 101:8 موازينه (و ز ن); 101:9 أمّه (ء م م); 101:11 حامية (ح م ي)
parent_channels.synthesis: Bodily appraisal and social placement meet in one household frame. Stature and composure describe visible presence, marriage kin define relational position, and bonded status marks dependence within that setting.

parent_channels.name: S3. Named Mountain and Topographic Identity
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A mountain becomes a proper name, a place of affiliation, and a fixed topographic reference.
parent_channels.active_motifs: Radwa as mountain-name (ر ض و:B007/m01); the same name in the parallel root family (ر ض ي:B003/m01); high solid mountain (ج ب ل:B001/m01); alignment beside a mountain (و ز ن:B003/m01)
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 101:5 الجبال (ج ب ل); 101:6,8 موازينه (و ز ن); 101:7 راضية (ر ض و); no direct surface occurrence for ر ض ي
parent_channels.synthesis: Physical prominence becomes identity. The mountain's stable mass supports naming and affiliation, while alignment places persons or objects in relation to that named landmark.

parent_channels.name: S4. Interrogative Choice and Adversative Turn
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Discourse presents an alternative, interrupts it with a turn, and redirects the hearer toward knowledge.
parent_channels.active_motifs: alternative interrogative (ء م م:B016/m01); adversative shift (ء م م:B016/m02); seeking or conveying knowledge (د ر ي:B001/m01, د ر ي:B001/m02)
parent_channels.synthesis: The interrogative opens competing possibilities, while the adversative use rejects or redirects the first line of thought. Knowledge is the discourse goal toward which that turn points.

parent_channels.name: S5. Palm Core, Frond, and Extremity Analogy
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Plant parts arranged around a central palm core are mapped onto bodily or tool-like extremities.
parent_channels.active_motifs: fronds beside the palm heart (ع ه ن:B004/m01); base of a date cluster (ع ه ن:B010/m01); fingertip or palm figure (ء ن س:B005/m02); thin plate or paired mechanical piece (ف ر ش:B010/m02)
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:5 العهن (ع ه ن); no direct surface occurrence for ء ن س
parent_channels.synthesis: A central stalk with radiating fronds supplies a structural analogy for hand, finger, and thin paired components. Position and attachment, rather than shared substance, hold the comparison together.

parent_channels.name: S6. Applied Lime and Stripped Surface
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A coating is spread over a body or exterior surface, removes covering, and leaves the underlying plane smooth and exposed.
parent_channels.active_motifs: applied depilatory lime (ن و ر:B009/m01); denuded or bald surface (ق ر ع:B008/m01); scraped smooth material (ق ر ع:B011/m01); spreading a layer (ف ر ش:B001/m01)
parent_channels.ayah_anchors: 101:1-3 القارعة (ق ر ع); 101:4 الفراش (ف ر ش); 101:11 نار (ن و ر)
parent_channels.synthesis: Application and stripping form one surface-treatment sequence. A material is laid over the exterior, covering is removed, and the result is a newly exposed, smoothed plane.
